purpose: Container and specification for the first dated empirical snapshot across AI systems, search environments and relevant platforms, measured after the prior interventions declared in the baseline plan.
important_note: This is not a pristine pre-intervention or pre-publication baseline. No empirical observation records have been populated; an empty records array must never be interpreted as zero visibility, zero recognition, or completed measurement.

required_before_freeze: Execute the declared baseline prompt set under documented conditions.
Store observation records and response snapshots/references.
Validate records against the Observatory protocol.
Assign freeze timestamp and immutable baseline version.

rules: Historical baseline records must never be overwritten by later interventions.
A baseline is frozen only after empirical observation records exist.
Prompt Registry version must remain fixed for direct before/after comparisons.
This snapshot follows the prior interventions declared in observatory/baseline-plan-v1.json; it cannot be used as a pre-change comparison for those interventions.
